messages.text: What are the most important signaling test capabilities for applications in Semiconductor?

### Evidence basis
Raw evidence says Rohde & Schwarz and MediaTek planned a 5G NTN-NR test setup and that R&S solutions can help with test and verification needs for NTN and other technologies [27].
Raw evidence also frames R&S and SPEAG work as test and measurement applications for the wireless industry [28].
The supported semiconductor-facing device class in the passages is “chipsets, modules and devices” that need interoperability and 3GPP Release 17 compliance for satellite-based IoT applications [21].
### Recommended main thrust
【推論】 Prioritize CMX500 signaling for R&D, protocol/performance/RF validation, NTN/cellular/WLAN interworking, and regulatory pre-conformance, then use CMP180 non-signaling RF for production-phase high-throughput RF test [6][7][20][21][27].
### Recommend selling first
CMX500 should lead for semiconductor R&D because it is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD device testing [6].
CMX500 should lead for NTN semiconductor programs because the Viasat NB-NTN IoT test plan is based on the CMX500 one-box signaling tester and covers protocol, performance and RF test scenarios [21].
CMX500 should lead for Wi-Fi 7 and cellular/WLAN combo development because it supports Wi-Fi 7 signaling-mode R&D tests, MLO, multiple RF chains, 2x2 MIMO, coexistence and E2E test capabilities [7].
CMP180 should be positioned for production because it is described as a production-phase non-signaling RF measurement tester supporting Wi-Fi 6E, Wi-Fi 7 and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz with bandwidths up to 500 MHz [7].
### Product and option mapping
| Product line | Semiconductor-facing need | Knowledge-base confirmed option / spec | Why it fits | Evidence | Gap / quote risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 / CMX500 Callbox | 5G modem and device R&D for new bands, sensitivity, RedCap, desense, pre-conformance, SRS RF, UL MIMO, UL CA, UL TX switching, Multi-SIM, high E2E throughput and non-signaling verification | LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD support are confirmed, and callbox use cases include the listed R&D and RF items | It is the broadest signaling entry point for cellular chipset/module/device validation | [5][6] | Semiconductor-specific pricing, option stack and coverage are not stated |
| R&S CMX500 for NTN / NB-NTN | Chipsets, modules and devices must interoperate with a satellite network and comply with 3GPP Release 17 standards | NR-NTN and NB-NTN testing is confirmed, and the test plan covers protocol, performance and RF scenarios | It directly addresses NTN IoT validation needs and matches the raw 5G NTN-NR test-and-verification theme | [21][27] | Formal option stack, order numbers and measured accuracy are not stated [17] |
| R&S CMX500 for Wi-Fi 7 / WLAN-cellular | Wi-Fi 7 and cellular/WLAN combo designs need signaling, MLO, multiple RF chains, 2x2 MIMO, coexistence, E2E and WLAN offload validation | WLAN signaling and TX measurements cover 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, 802.11bn and 2x2 MIMO | It enables single-instrument cellular and non-cellular R&D tests | [6][7] | The MWC Wi-Fi 7 source does not provide formal option codes, software version or hardware BOM [12] |
| R&S CMX500 application / audio / IP options | Application-layer, IP traffic, IMS, audio and voice-quality validation are needed for connected devices | CMX-KA100, CMX-KA110, CMX-KA150, CMX-KA180, CMX-KA181 and CMX-KA401 are listed for application test, IP traffic analysis, audio enabler, POLQA and application-test audio | These options support end-to-end application and voice-quality checks beyond pure RF | [23] | Exact semiconductor test plans and customer-required scripts are not stated |
| R&S CMX500 fading / scenario options | Channel emulation and conformance-style RF stress are needed for LTE, NR and NTN validation | CMX-KE500, CMX-KE501, CMX-KE600, CMX-KE601, CMX-KE611, CMX-KE620, CMX-KE621, CMX-KC550B, CMX-KC660B, CMX-KC661B and CMX-KC665B are listed | These options support fading, NTN fading, user-defined profiles and LTE/NR/NR-NTN 3GPP RF test scenarios | [23] | The passages do not state which options are mandatory for any named semiconductor customer |
| R&S CMW500 / CMX500 for SAR, HAC and EMC signaling | Wireless devices need signaling to drive extreme transmit conditions, average-SAR behavior, enabled/disabled radio states and audio breakthrough tests | CMW500 and CMX500 are named as SAR/HAC signaling solutions, and CMX500 powers 5G NR functionality in R&S EMC systems | These capabilities support compliance-readiness work that semiconductor reference designs often need before device launch | [3][15] | The passages do not prove full coverage of all bands, categories or Audio Breakthrough configurations [19] |
| R&S CMP180 | Production RF testing for Wi-Fi 6E, Wi-Fi 7 and 5G NR FR1 devices | 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz, bandwidths up to 500 MHz, two analyzers, two generators, two sets of eight RF ports, 2x2 MIMO, and scalable 4x4 MIMO access-point testing are confirmed | It is the main non-signaling production tester complementing CMX500 R&D signaling | [7][20] | Semiconductor ATE integration, handler control and production throughput numbers are not stated |
### Scenario entry points
| Scenario | Recommended combination | Selling focus | Unverified items |
|---|---|---|---|
| NTN / NB-NTN IoT chipset, module or device validation | CMX500 NTN signaling | Emphasize protocol, performance and RF scenarios, 3GPP Release 17 compliance and satellite-network interoperability | Exact CMX500 NTN option stack is not stated [17][21] |
| 5G NR modem RF R&D | CMX500 Callbox | Emphasize new bands, sensitivity, RedCap, pre-conformance, SRS RF, UL MIMO, UL CA and UL TX switching | Customer-specific bands and conformance scope are not stated [5] |
| Wi-Fi 7 plus 5G combo connectivity | CMX500 for R&D and CMP180 for production | Emphasize CMX500 signaling/interworking and CMP180 non-signaling production RF | Formal Wi-Fi 7 option codes are not stated [7][12][20] |
| Voice, IMS and application quality | CMX500 application, IP traffic, audio and POLQA options | Emphasize application test, IP traffic analysis, IMS/audio and POLQA measurement | Required app scripts and operator profiles are not stated [6][23] |
| Compliance-readiness for wireless devices | CMX500 or CMW500 with SAR/HAC/EMC systems | Emphasize network emulation for extreme transmit states, average-SAR, radio-enabled EMC and Audio Breakthrough | Full regulatory coverage cannot be inferred from these passages [3][19] |
| Production RF for Wi-Fi and 5G FR1 | CMP180 | Emphasize non-signaling RF, 8 GHz, 500 MHz bandwidth, dual analyzers/generators and multiport MIMO scalability | Semiconductor production integration details are not stated [7] |

### Evidence basis
Raw evidence says Rohde & Schwarz and MediaTek planned a 5G NTN-NR test setup and that R&S solutions can help with test and verification needs for NTN and other technologies [27].
Raw evidence also frames R&S and SPEAG work as test and measurement applications for the wireless industry [28].
The supported semiconductor-facing device class in the passages is “chipsets, modules and devices” that need interoperability and 3GPP Release 17 compliance for satellite-based IoT applications [21].
### Recommended main thrust
【推論】 Prioritize CMX500 signaling for R&D, protocol/performance/RF validation, NTN/cellular/WLAN interworking, and regulatory pre-conformance, then use CMP180 non-signaling RF for production-phase high-throughput RF test [6][7][20][21][27].
### Recommend selling first
CMX500 should lead for semiconductor R&D because it is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD device testing [6].
CMX500 should lead for NTN semiconductor programs because the Viasat NB-NTN IoT test plan is based on the CMX500 one-box signaling tester and covers protocol, performance and RF test scenarios [21].
CMX500 should lead for Wi-Fi 7 and cellular/WLAN combo development because it supports Wi-Fi 7 signaling-mode R&D tests, MLO, multiple RF chains, 2x2 MIMO, coexistence and E2E test capabilities [7].
CMP180 should be positioned for production because it is described as a production-phase non-signaling RF measurement tester supporting Wi-Fi 6E, Wi-Fi 7 and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz with bandwidths up to 500 MHz [7].
### Product and option mapping
| Product line | Semiconductor-facing need | Knowledge-base confirmed option / spec | Why it fits | Evidence | Gap / quote risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 / CMX500 Callbox | 5G modem and device R&D for new bands, sensitivity, RedCap, desense, pre-conformance, SRS RF, UL MIMO, UL CA, UL TX switching, Multi-SIM, high E2E throughput and non-signaling verification | LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD support are confirmed, and callbox use cases include the listed R&D and RF items | It is the broadest signaling entry point for cellular chipset/module/device validation | [5][6] | Semiconductor-specific pricing, option stack and coverage are not stated |
| R&S CMX500 for NTN / NB-NTN | Chipsets, modules and devices must interoperate with a satellite network and comply with 3GPP Release 17 standards | NR-NTN and NB-NTN testing is confirmed, and the test plan covers protocol, performance and RF scenarios | It directly addresses NTN IoT validation needs and matches the raw 5G NTN-NR test-and-verification theme | [21][27] | Formal option stack, order numbers and measured accuracy are not stated [17] |
| R&S CMX500 for Wi-Fi 7 / WLAN-cellular | Wi-Fi 7 and cellular/WLAN combo designs need signaling, MLO, multiple RF chains, 2x2 MIMO, coexistence, E2E and WLAN offload validation | WLAN signaling and TX measurements cover 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, 802.11bn and 2x2 MIMO | It enables single-instrument cellular and non-cellular R&D tests | [6][7] | The MWC Wi-Fi 7 source does not provide formal option codes, software version or hardware BOM [12] |
| R&S CMX500 application / audio / IP options | Application-layer, IP traffic, IMS, audio and voice-quality validation are needed for connected devices | CMX-KA100, CMX-KA110, CMX-KA150, CMX-KA180, CMX-KA181 and CMX-KA401 are listed for application test, IP traffic analysis, audio enabler, POLQA and application-test audio | These options support end-to-end application and voice-quality checks beyond pure RF | [23] | Exact semiconductor test plans and customer-required scripts are not stated |
| R&S CMX500 fading / scenario options | Channel emulation and conformance-style RF stress are needed for LTE, NR and NTN validation | CMX-KE500, CMX-KE501, CMX-KE600, CMX-KE601, CMX-KE611, CMX-KE620, CMX-KE621, CMX-KC550B, CMX-KC660B, CMX-KC661B and CMX-KC665B are listed | These options support fading, NTN fading, user-defined profiles and LTE/NR/NR-NTN 3GPP RF test scenarios | [23] | The passages do not state which options are mandatory for any named semiconductor customer |
| R&S CMW500 / CMX500 for SAR, HAC and EMC signaling | Wireless devices need signaling to drive extreme transmit conditions, average-SAR behavior, enabled/disabled radio states and audio breakthrough tests | CMW500 and CMX500 are named as SAR/HAC signaling solutions, and CMX500 powers 5G NR functionality in R&S EMC systems | These capabilities support compliance-readiness work that semiconductor reference designs often need before device launch | [3][15] | The passages do not prove full coverage of all bands, categories or Audio Breakthrough configurations [19] |
| R&S CMP180 | Production RF testing for Wi-Fi 6E, Wi-Fi 7 and 5G NR FR1 devices | 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz, bandwidths up to 500 MHz, two analyzers, two generators, two sets of eight RF ports, 2x2 MIMO, and scalable 4x4 MIMO access-point testing are confirmed | It is the main non-signaling production tester complementing CMX500 R&D signaling | [7][20] | Semiconductor ATE integration, handler control and production throughput numbers are not stated |
### Scenario entry points
| Scenario | Recommended combination | Selling focus | Unverified items |
|---|---|---|---|
| NTN / NB-NTN IoT chipset, module or device validation | CMX500 NTN signaling | Emphasize protocol, performance and RF scenarios, 3GPP Release 17 compliance and satellite-network interoperability | Exact CMX500 NTN option stack is not stated [17][21] |
| 5G NR modem RF R&D | CMX500 Callbox | Emphasize new bands, sensitivity, RedCap, pre-conformance, SRS RF, UL MIMO, UL CA and UL TX switching | Customer-specific bands and conformance scope are not stated [5] |
| Wi-Fi 7 plus 5G combo connectivity | CMX500 for R&D and CMP180 for production | Emphasize CMX500 signaling/interworking and CMP180 non-signaling production RF | Formal Wi-Fi 7 option codes are not stated [7][12][20] |
| Voice, IMS and application quality | CMX500 application, IP traffic, audio and POLQA options | Emphasize application test, IP traffic analysis, IMS/audio and POLQA measurement | Required app scripts and operator profiles are not stated [6][23] |
| Compliance-readiness for wireless devices | CMX500 or CMW500 with SAR/HAC/EMC systems | Emphasize network emulation for extreme transmit states, average-SAR, radio-enabled EMC and Audio Breakthrough | Full regulatory coverage cannot be inferred from these passages [3][19] |
| Production RF for Wi-Fi and 5G FR1 | CMP180 | Emphasize non-signaling RF, 8 GHz, 500 MHz bandwidth, dual analyzers/generators and multiport MIMO scalability | Semiconductor production integration details are not stated [7] |
